summary: Vassalboro (Kennebec County) tower site on the FFLOS register since 2008; the tower was disassembled in 2000 and placed in storage. No build date or staffing record found.

facts.status_note: Register says the tower was disassembled in 2000 and placed in storage; no source found describes the site today

events.note: Tower disassembled and placed in storage, per the register

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only the FFLOS detail page and the FFLOS state index are tower-specific. The Maine Atlas page is statewide context and is not tied to Cook Hill's own watch years, so the story does not claim Cook Hill was staffed to 1991. Facebook posts from the FFLA Maine chapter appear in search results with claims that the tower was built in 1949, manned through the 1991 season, and trucked away in 2000 by a private party. The Facebook pages returned only a login shell, so none of those claims is used; they are leads to check against a readable source. Brief record matches: registered 2008 and gone. No access information found.
